summary: Promoted J-09 (the backend discloses its own background-compute activity on the canonical GET /api/health + badge + /data, one producer/one endpoint, no schema change) closing the one partially-uncovered Vision claim: 'the UI tells the truth about the backend's own state ... and about data jobs (progress, ...)' is journeyed for boot phase/crash (J-04) and ingest jobs (J-01) but NOT for the request-triggered background-compute window, whose in-process registry no endpoint reads and whose caught MemoryError failure is invisible in the UI; all 6 Key Capabilities remain covered by J-01/J-03/J-04/J-05/J-06.
